sample_unit: patient education handouts per language (ChatGPT-4o vs AAO), rated by 3 ophthalmologists per language

links.outcome: Readability and grade level of AI-generated handouts versus AAO handouts
links.effect: ChatGPT-4o English SMOG 7.86 vs AAO 7.49 (P=0.35); grade levels comparable; Spanish SPPI 60.26 vs 64.82 (P=0.04)
links.quote: ChatGPT-4o handouts had English readability similar to that of AAO (SMOG 7.86 ± 0.53 vs. 7.49 ± 0.76; P = 0.35) but significantly lower Spanish SPPI scores (60.26 ± 4.47 vs. 64.82 ± 2.97; P = 0.04).

links.outcome: Plain-language readability of AI-generated patient education materials
links.effect: ChatGPT-4o handouts at ~8th-grade level with readability similar to AAO in English; grade levels comparable; Spanish quality scores higher (15.83 vs 14.23; P<0.001)
links.quote: ChatGPT-generated materials matched or exceeded AAO handouts in readability and content quality, with Spanish versions being most preferred.

screen.reason: Evaluates the quality and readability of patient educational handouts generated by ChatGPT-4o compared to American Academy of Ophthalmology materials; does not test a specific deployment safeguard or implementation practice.
